title: Unblocking evidence
current: A blocker at done always satisfies fact:merged regardless of edge age. For an unfinished blocker, fact:merged requires its recorded merged_at strictly after the edge’s created_at. A blocker with no recorded landing reads merge_not_landed, a normal wait; merge_landing_unverified means the recorded landing time is invalid or the edge has no creation time. Earlier landings, branch ancestry and other lifecycle statuses cannot clear an unfinished blocker’s newly declared wait. Create a new edge before a needed re-landing; updates preserve the clock. Each durable edge owns its dependency notice identity. For correction waits, fact:merged fits a fix that ships in the dependent's release or is proven by the same shared QA case; status:done requires completion; fact:deployed:ENV also requires durable completion attribution to that registered environment, so use it only when the dependent needs the fix live before its own release, because composition skips a dependent whose blocker ships in that same release. Same-run co-scheduling permits admission, not persisted satisfaction or proof of an available retest target. Reread all remaining blockers on any notice.
